text:
alex: Customer S-2143 reporting CSV usage export for org `acme-inc` is missing rows for 2024-10-12 and 2024-10-13. Dashboard shows tokens for those dates but CSV sum is lower than invoice total. Anyone seen this pattern before?

maria: I have — usually exporter crashes or timezone/window edge cases. Do we have the export job logs for those dates?

alex: @maria attaching a tiny excerpt from the customer's CSV vs dashboard totals: 
```
date,tokens
2024-10-11,1,234,567
2024-10-12,
2024-10-13,
2024-10-14,980,123
```
Dashboard shows tokens on 2024-10-12 = 456,789 and 2024-10-13 = 512,345 (so invoice > CSV). :thinking_face:

ops-bot: daily-export job (daily-export-prod) 2024-10-13 00:05 failed on runner-04 with exit code 137. Retry scheduled.

jamie: Exit 137 means OOM/kill. That could drop the file upload for that day. Note: billing aggregation pipeline is separate and ran successfully, so invoice still includes those tokens.

ian: Repro / triage steps for eng: 1) check exporter logs: `/var/log/export/daily-export-2024-10-13.log` 2) check S3 path: `s3://redwood-exports/prod/acme-inc/2024-10-13.csv` 3) run re-export locally: `scripts/export_range --org acme-inc --start 2024-10-12 --end 2024-10-13` 4) verify checksum + upload.

maria: I re-ran the export on staging and the rows are produced correctly. Looks like the prod exporter OOM dropped the file. I'll queue a backfill for prod and add an alert for exporter OOMs. :+1:

liz: From billing side: invoice totals are correct — this is a reporting/export artifact. We should tell the customer that billing is accurate and we'll backfill the CSV. ETA?

maria: Backfill job queued: `bf-9876`. ETA ~2 hours. It will generate the missing CSVs and re-upload to S3. I'll update this thread when done. :eyes:

ops-bot: bf-9876 started on runner-12 at 1726504500.

jamie: After backfill, let's run a reconcile step: sum(CSV rows) vs billing API for last 7 days and raise an alert if delta > 1%. Also consider retry/backoff improvements for exporter to avoid silent skips.

alex: Good plan. For support reply to S-2143: explain (a) exporter crashed (exit 137), (b) billing pipeline is independent and invoice is correct, (c) we've queued a backfill and will re-upload CSVs, (d) temporary workaround: use dashboard or billing API endpoints to get authoritative totals.

maria: Drafting the support response now, will CC @liz for billing language and paste backfill job link. Adding a short KB article to support docs describing missing-day causes (export crash, timezone window, job eviction).

ops-bot: bf-9876 completed successfully at 1726504688, uploaded `s3://redwood-exports/prod/acme-inc/2024-10-12.csv` and `2024-10-13.csv`.

maria: Backfill complete. I verified CSV sums match billing API within 0.2%. Posting final message to customer and closing internal ticket.

jamie: Nice. Follow-up: open a small RFC to add a reconcile nightly job and alerting on exporter nonzero exit codes.

maria: Adding RFC to eng backlog and assigning to oncall for a 7-day reconcile. Closing thread once customer confirms.
